evidence.note: Runs the specific i32 spec JSON and reads the first failures, localizing broken assertions rather than treating pass rate as opaque.
Classic tight loop: edit runtime → rebuild → re-run tests → check remaining block failures, confirming the fix and finding what's left.
Isolates SIMD families (simd_lane, simd_load) and reads their specific execution failures, then runs all SIMD tests.
Repeatedly runs the aggregate score and filters to only files with failures to confirm no regressions across already-green files while iterating.
Disassembles the actual wasm binaries with wabt to distinguish decode/encoding bugs from semantic bugs by narrowing to the failing function.
Ends by computing per-file MVP and SIMD scores, sustaining the per-family verification view to the finish.

reasoning: The agent runs individual per-family spec JSON files after implementing/fixing each area, reads exact FAIL lines to localize bugs, re-runs after fixes, and uses the aggregate run to confirm no regressions across green files — matching the level-8 anchor's tight, self-correcting loop, including disassembling binaries to separate decode from semantic bugs. It falls short of level 10 because the descriptions show no deliberate targeting of the subtle SIMD edge cases (canonical NaN, saturation boundaries, signed/unsigned extract, rounding modes) as designed verification.
